Intermediate.learningGoal: Implement an accumulator-based fixed timestep driven by a passed-in frame dt.
gotchas: Large frame dt causes the spiral of death unless clamped
The remainder must carry over to the next frame
goodSolutionShows: Accumulator with while loop and clamp on max steps
Deterministic update count for given dts
No real clock; dt passed in
shapeHints: running physics at 60 Hz regardless of frame time
counting updates for a series of frame dts

Advanced.learningGoal: Add interpolation, pausing and time scaling while keeping the simulation deterministic.
gotchas: Floating point accumulation drift across many frames
Time scale applied to dt before accumulation, not to step size
goodSolutionShows: Interpolated state computed from previous and current
Replay determinism proven by running the same dts twice
shapeHints: an interpolated position between two physics states
a loop supporting pause and slow-mo
a replay test feeding recorded frame dts

Expert.learningGoal: Make simulation deterministic and rewindable: snapshots, seeded randomness and input recording.
gotchas: Using math.random breaks determinism; pass a seeded generator function in
Table iteration order (pairs) is nondeterministic across runs
goodSolutionShows: Injected rng function and ordered iteration
Equality of replayed state to original
shapeHints: a simulation using an injected pseudo-random function
a recorded input replay matching the original
